notes.title: Hero of the Kingdom II v1.3.11 Patch
notes.notes:
Changes in the version 1.3.11
-Removed some unnecessary API calls.
-Fixes in the translations.

notes.title: Hero of the Kingdom II v1.25 patch
notes.notes:
Changes in the version 1.25:
-Added Simplified Chinese localization
-Fixes in Brazilian Portuguese and Ukrainian translations

notes.title: Hero of the Kingdom II v1.24 patch
notes.notes:
Changes in the version 1.24:
-Changed game fonts. The new fonts are somewhat larger and more readable.
-Added Greek characters to the fonts.
-Added Chinese Han characters to the fonts.
-Removed quotation marks on the text when NPCs speak.

notes.title: Hero of the Kingdom II v1.23 patch
notes.notes:
v1.23 changes:
-Windows executable is now 64-bit by default. A separate 32-bit executable is provided for a backward compatibility.
-Fixed a small visual glitch on low resolution displays.
-macOS application bundle rearranged to the regular format
-macOS system requirement increased from 10.6 to 10.8
-Corrections in Italian translation
